decision.reasoning_trace: I specifically looked for highly-rated products that matched the category search for 'Backpacks'. The HIKPRO 20L Packable Backpack (prod_backpacks_006) was the strongest option due to its massive review count of over 2,800 and a 4.7-star rating at a very competitive price. The Gelindo hydration pack (prod_backpacks_078) was a secondary consideration as it is an 'Overall Pick', but one review mentioned needing repairs, whereas the HIKPRO seems more consistently reliable for travel and hiking. The other items in the consideration set (sling, mesh, and fishing backpacks) represented specialized needs, but the HIKPRO offers the best general value.
